params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of results to return. Defaults to 50, maximum of 100.

params.name: createdAt.gte
params.description: Datetime, in RFC 3339 format. Time zone defaults to UTC. Restricts results to those modified in the specified range. e.g. "2020-05-23".

params.name: startingAfter
params.description: Event ID after which events will be returned.

params.name: eventTypes
params.description: Comma-separated list of event types to return.

params.name: poll
params.description: When True, the API will always return a nextToken to enable polling events indefinitely.

## Event Sort Order

Events in Benchling are assigned a stable sort order that reflects when the event was processed (not created). The createdAt time is not the stable sorted order of events. For this reason event createdAt time may appear out of order.
